name: SCRUM-9 - Cancel and Confirm User Deletion
objective: Verify that cancelling deletion retains a dedicated user and confirming deletion removes it.
precondition: The administrator can create a dedicated ESS test user.

steps.description: Request deletion of the dedicated test user and cancel the confirmation dialog.
steps.expectedResult: The confirmation dialog closes and the user remains in the list.

steps.description: Request deletion again and confirm it.
steps.expectedResult: A success notification appears, the user is removed, and the result count is updated.
